title: Stable rerank raises ValueError when score matrices differ in shape
description: apply_stable_rerank_scores fails with 'model_scores and tfidf_scores must have the same shape' after filtering candidates.

title: Metadata rerank ignores component weights from CLI
description: Passing --rerank-fields component:0.05 has no effect; parse_field_weights returns defaults.

title: load_tickets crashes on CSV without description column
description: KeyError when the Bugzilla export only has summary and comments columns.

title: Duplicate groups merged incorrectly for chained duplicates
description: A duplicate of a duplicate ends in a different group; UnionFind find() does not compress paths.

title: SBERT training runs out of memory with large batch size
description: train-sbert with batch size 64 crashes CUDA OOM on 8GB GPU.

title: Triplet builder produces empty negatives for small groups
description: build_triplets returns no negatives when a duplicate group has only two tickets.

title: Threshold tuning reports precision above 1.0
description: tune_query_threshold divides by the wrong denominator when there are no positives.

title: Review queue CSV breaks Excel because of newlines
description: export_duplicate_review_queue writes raw newlines in description cells.

title: Typo in README quick start command
description: The README says duplicate_ticket_detecton instead of duplicate_ticket_detection.

title: TF-IDF detector returns NaN scores for empty titles
description: Tickets with an empty summary produce NaN similarity and are ranked first.
